system.description:
As a part of casting and benefiting from this jutsu, you must be in a Taijutsu Stance. If you are not, its effects immediately ends.

When you move 10 or more feet before making a melee attack, you can cast this jutsu, granting yourself a +1 bonus your attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

These bonuses last until the beginning of your next turn, stacking up to twice. Each time you cast this jutsu, you must move 10 or more feet and perform a melee attack targeting either the same or another creature.

Creatures who’s attack result would be equal to your AC counts as a miss for the duration. If you would succeed a Dexterity saving throw while gaining the benefit of this jutsu you take no damage and suffer no effects. Finally, the first time you would be hit by an attack while gaining the benefit of this jutsu, you lose its benefits.
